skill.descTemplate: 使用声骸技能，召唤角，生成停滞区域，持续{0}秒，期间附近队伍中所有角色破共振度能力提升{1}，受到停滞区域影响的敌人防御力降低{2}、所有抗性降低{3}。期间角腾跃而起，对目标造成{4}的衍射伤害并降下光雷，对周围目标造成最多五段，每段{5}的衍射伤害，随后向下盘旋攻击，连续造成2次{6}的衍射伤害。技能冷却：{7}秒

skill.descEnRank5: Summon Jué to generate a stagnation field that lasts for 5s. While active, it increases nearby party members' Vibration Strength Depletion Rate by 500.00%. Enemies in the filed have their DEF reduced by 30.00% and RES to All Attributes reduced by 30.00%. During this time, Jué soars through the air and deals 246.81% Spectro DMG while summoning thunderbolts that strike nearby enemies up to 5 times, each dealing 47.85% Spectro DMG. Jué then spirals downward, attacking surrounding enemies twice, each dealing 119.61% Spectro DMG. Cooldown: 40s.
